item.title: [New] ThreatHunting.ReadWrite.All enters Microsoft's Graph permissions file with 13 endpoints: run hunting queries and create, change and delete saved hunting functions
item.description:
An app granted this permission can rewrite or delete the saved hunting functions detection engineers build queries on, not only read data; it is a write path into shared detection logic and is not yet described on Learn.

Graph · Alert on any consent or app-role assignment of ThreatHunting.ReadWrite.All (AuditLogs: 'Add app role assignment to service principal' with the Application ID 6e251752-0d87-4158-b87b-b60e768fa657) and keep hunting automation on ThreatHunting.Read.All unless it must write functions.

item.title: [New] Entra MFA shows non-telephony methods before SMS and voice and adds a resend wait; Microsoft re-posted it on 10 November with the content unchanged
item.description:
The resend wait looks like an SMS delivery failure to users and the help desk, and help-desk MFA resets are the social-engineering path attackers use.

Entra · Brief the help desk that a resend wait is not a delivery failure and that SMS/voice sit under 'Show more verification methods'; keep moving users to passkeys before 1 February 2027.

item.title: [New] Entra Hard Deletion Protection (preview): a protected user, cloud group, app or service principal cannot be permanently deleted for seven days after soft delete, and the protection can never be removed
item.description:
A destructive intruder with Global Administrator can soft delete and then hard delete break-glass accounts, Conditional Access exclusion groups or critical app registrations in minutes; a seven-day floor turns that into a recoverable event, and the audit record of enabling it is a new event to watch.

Entra · Pilot it on break-glass accounts, privileged-access groups and the service principals your SOC tooling depends on, remembering it cannot be removed; add the enable event and blocked hard-delete attempts to your Entra audit detections.
